'''Rockmites''' were small, six-legged [[Insect/Legends|insects]] that lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] and swarmed on [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]].

==History==
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Animal Control [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Entha Kandela]] tasked a spacer to eliminate rockmites around [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] to collect their egg sacks in order to manufacture artificial scent to drive the nesting mother mites further away from the city.<ref name="SWG:ACO">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Animal Control Officer|Tatooine}}</ref>

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:IDontThinkThisIsADroch.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Tatooine "mite" concept art for ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.]]
Rockmites appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Rockmites were almost identical to [[cave beetle]]s, [[rock beetle]]s, [[Sand beetle/Legends|sand beetles]] and [[Dune beetle/Legends|dune beetles]], using the same base model with different textures.<ref name="SWG" />
